Class DirectoryIcon

java.lang.Object
DirectoryIcon
All Implemented Interfaces:
FSIcon
public class DirectoryIcon extends Object implements FSIcon
Composite: a directory icon that contains child icons (files or directories). Uses a shared FOLDER flyweight for its own rendering, and lays out children.
